scope: Read-only visual audit of actual centralized emulator captures. No game art, binaries, C, shared metadata, emulator or build executed or changed by this review.

findings.subject: Six complete architectural landmarks
findings.details: Church at[48,32,200,112], market at[416,144,192,112], house at[800,32,160,112], workshop at[1248,32,192,112], southern garage at[1712,144,240,112], final warehouse at[2288,32,240,128] each retain roof, wall, doorway and physical base in at least one legal runtime view. This is observed in the six actual landmark pictures, in addition to the capture metadata visibility flag.

findings.subject: HUD and actor visibility
findings.details: No sampled hero head crosses the24px HUD and no sampled feet are cut by the lower image edge. Smallest sampled feetY is88; exactY80 is not pictured. Integrated EARLY_ARENA03 has minY80; at cameraY0 the renderer formula80−31−16 gives headY33, below HUD24. The formula is source evidence, not an additional emulator measurement.

findings.subject: Southern parcel closures and floors
findings.details: The market parcel x352..672 and garage parcel x1648..2000 have continuous visible stone side limits and lower wall caps. The48px northwest entries remain legible. Surfaces and corners retain the same materials across adjacent overlapping captures; no observed missing map tiles, corrupted fragments, opaque alpha rectangles or unexpected black floor. Camera3/x3-y2 and3/x11-y2 show the lower frontage and closure;3/x4-y1 and3/x12-y1 show side walls and returns.

findings.subject: Traversal geometry
findings.details: The integrated layout contains the two visible south closures and minY80, matching the authored geometry. Root reports the final regional traversal/control suites passed. This visual-only review did not itself run movement/collision tests; it does not derive collision success from the screenshot pixels.

findings.subject: Materials and architectural rhythm
findings.details: Shared roof/plaster/opening vocabulary remains noticeable, and road areas are deliberately quiet and broad between parcels. Distinct church, market, residence, workshop with truck, south garage and arrival roller gate remain readable. This is a composition judgment based on this candidate, not inherited approval from earlier panoramas.

limitations: Captures seed snapshots and suppress enemies, damage/progress/auto-interaction; they demonstrate native camera/background rendering with a visible actor, not combat difficulty, maximum enemy load or ordinary complete gameplay.
Only the intact church branch appears in these114phase3pictures. The ruined variant has prior exact source/bank checks but no separate actual ruined-phase3 screenshot in this review set.
Settled sampled frames cannot prove every intervening camera interpolation frame; overlapping17columns improve coverage but do not replace a continuous movie.
Exact minY80 and the two northwest yard entrances were not exercised by movement in this review; the source geometry and centralized control suite are separate evidence.
Some other sampled views naturally show only part of a building while scrolling; each of the six designated landmark frames shows the complete building.
artifact_policy: Only files below streets/3/reviews/runtime232e were created or changed. Native PNGs, palettes, tile/map banks, authored manifests, game C and release ROM were read only.
